les.title: 🏋 Drill: check se bacho (defence 1)
les.sub: Asli games ki positions: sabse achha bachaav chuno
yaad: Check se bachne ke 3 tareeke: king hatao, block, capture.
Sabse achha woh jisme kuch na khoye.

steps.md:
Achha player sirf attack nahi karta, **bachaav** bhi karta hai. Yahan har position mein tumhe **check** mila hai. Teeno tareeke socho (king hatao, block, capture) aur **sabse achha** chuno.

Jawab Stockfish se check kiye gaye hain.

Test: 10 naye positions, **80%**.

steps.q: **Check!** Bachne ke 3 tareeke: king hatao, block karo, ya checking piece capture karo. **Sabse achha** tareeka chuno.
steps.why: Best: `Bd7`: beech mein piece rakh kar check block kiya. Har tareeka barabar nahi hota: dekho kahan piece ya king zyada safe hai.
steps.hint: Teeno tareeke dekho, phir woh chuno jisme kuch nahi khota.

steps.q: **Check!** Bachne ke 3 tareeke: king hatao, block karo, ya checking piece capture karo. **Sabse achha** tareeka chuno.
steps.why: Best: `Kf3`: king ko safe square par hataya. Yeh bhi theek thi: `Kg3`, `Kh5`. Har tareeka barabar nahi hota: dekho kahan piece ya king zyada safe hai.
steps.hint: Teeno tareeke dekho, phir woh chuno jisme kuch nahi khota.

les.title: 🏋 Drill: khatre mein piece bachao (defence 2)
les.sub: Attack mein aaye piece ko bina kuch khoye bachao
yaad: Har chaal se pehle: mera koi piece attack mein to nahi?
Bachao: hatao, protect karo, ya beech mein rok do.

steps.md:
Opponent ne tumhare ek piece par attack kiya hai. Use **bachao**, aur dhyan rakho ki bachate waqt koi **doosra piece latak** na jaaye.

Test: 10 naye positions, **80%**.

steps.q: Tumhara **queen** `e3` par khatre mein hai. Use bachao (aur kuch aur mat khona).
steps.why: Best: `Qd4`. Chaal ke baad dekho: naya square safe hai? Koi doosra piece latak to nahi gaya?
steps.hint: Piece ko safe square par le jao, ya use protect karo.
